summary: This is a resource management game where you control a lunar outpost, needing to keep as many astronauts alive as possible while in a simulated space environment with occasional radiation storms and missions you need to complete before a deadline. We designed it with kids aged 9-12 in mind, specially making sure that it wasn't a walk in the park, and that every action had its pros and its cons.
details: Our intention with this game was to teach kids and teens about the resource management involved in a space mission. We used JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Our project is creative it implements real data provided by NASA and pressures kids to make decisions while they play. We considered the consumption by every astronaut as well as the solar waves and radiation.
